name: Africa Data Centres Kigali KGL1
notes: Africa Data Centres announced its first Kigali data centre in November 2022, stating 2MW IT load and Q1 2023 groundbreaking; Baxtel lists ADC Kigali KGL1 as Rwanda's single tracked facility and under construction. Exact Kigali site not publicly specified in the announcement.

name: PAIX Kigali Data Centre
notes: DataCenterMap lists PAIX Kigali as planned, site code KGL-1, within Kigali Innovation City, and shows 3MW in the listing title. The 2025 Xalam/D4D market brief says the arrival of ADC and PAIX will bring Rwanda's first built-for-purpose carrier-neutral facilities; capacity should be treated as directory-reported until confirmed by PAIX.

name: AOS National Data Center
notes: AOS official pages state it is an ICT service provider and operator of Rwanda's National Data Center, offering cloud, hosting, and server colocation from Kigali; DataCenterMap locates the facility at Kigali Business Centre, KN 5 Rd.

name: TrAC Kigali / My.cloud Tier III data center
notes: TransAfrica Communications' official cloud page describes its Cloud service as locally hosted in a Tier 3 data center with 99.98% uptime; DataCenterMap lists TrAC Kigali at Telecom House, 8 KG 7 Ave and notes Axiom Networks rebranded as TrAC in September 2021.
